summary: 22nd Century Group filed an 8-K/A to correct the exercise price of Inducement Warrants in its warrant inducement offering. On June 8, 2026, it commenced a warrant inducement offering with holders of Existing Warrants for up to 5,345,591 shares at $3.57 per share. Holders exercised all Existing Warrants for cash at a reduced exercise price of $0.4626 per share, receiving 100% Inducement Warrants exercisable at $3.57 after stockholder approval, expiring five years post-approval. Anti-dilution provisions apply. This is a capital return event as it incentivizes warrant exercise, reducing overhang. Watch for stockholder vote and potential dilution impact.
